title: fix(components): element:text renders its declared inline Markdown, with a link-scheme allow-list shared with the marketplace README renderer (objectui#12778)
body:
Fixes #12778
Clause-②: yes

## What

`element:text` now renders the inline Markdown its spec declares. `ElementTextPropsSchema.content` is described as "Text or Markdown content" (objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`), but `ElementTextRenderer` printed `pickLocalized(content)` as typed. The named producer is objectstack-ai/cloud#2918 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2937): the pricing footer's sales address had to become a separate button.

- The inline half of the console's zero-dependency README renderer (`MarkdownText` in `@object-ui/app-shell`, its `renderInline` and the inline raw-HTML grammar) moves into `@object-ui/components` as `renderInlineMarkdown` (`packages/components/src/lib/inline-markdown.tsx`).
- `element:text` renders its content, a string or a locale map, through it inside its single p or h1-h6 tag.
- `MarkdownText` calls the same function and keeps only its block parser. There is one implementation and no new dependency.

## Behaviour

- **Inline subset:** `**bold**`, `*italic*`, single-backtick `code`, `[text](url)`, all drawn as React elements, never as an HTML string.
- **Raw HTML** is skipped: neither rendered nor printed, as objectui#12146 does for READMEs.
- **Link safety:** an href survives only for `http:`, `https:`, `mailto:`, `tel:`, or a scheme-less path, query or fragment. Any other scheme (`javascript:`, `data:`, `vbscript:`, any case), or an href containing whitespace or a control character, prints the link text with no anchor. React 19 blocks `javascript:` itself; this package's peer range admits React 18, which does not. **This also fixes the marketplace README renderer**, which passed href through as written.
- **Block syntax** in `element:text` (a `#` heading, a `- ` or `1. ` item, a fence) prints as typed. The tag holds one line of inline content. A code span is a single backtick pair, so a typed fence stays literal.
- **Plain text is unchanged:** a lone `*`, `2 * 3 * 4`, `snake_case`, `__dunder__`, bracket text without a destination, and `a < b`. Emphasis delimiters follow CommonMark's flanking rule in its simplest form.
- **Link target:** `element:text` opens `http(s):` and protocol-relative links in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. A same-site path, `mailto:` and `tel:` stay in the current tab. README links all open a new tab, as before.

## Clause-②

yes. The `@object-ui/components` entry gains `renderInlineMarkdown`, the type `InlineMarkdownOptions`, and `RAW_HTML_OPEN_TAG` / `RAW_HTML_CLOSING_TAG` (RegExp sources). They are exported because app-shell's README renderer imports them, which keeps one copy of the inline pass and of the tag grammar its HTML-block rules use. No existing export changes, and no prop or language-pack key is added.

## Tests

- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/element-text-markdown-12778.test.tsx`:
  - link and bold from the producer's sentence;
  - a localized content map in zh-CN;
  - new-tab and same-tab targets;
  - italic and code;
  - CONTROLS: six refused hrefs, raw HTML (an img tag with an onerror handler, and a b tag), plain-text shapes, block syntax.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarkdownText.linkScheme-12778.test.tsx`: refused schemes in a paragraph and a list item; CONTROL: the README inline pass renders as before (href, new tab, link class, emphasis in a heading, paragraph and list).
- The existing objectui#12146 README fixtures pass unchanged.
- **Ablations** (each restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty):
  - verbatim output: 11 of 21 red;
  - href passthrough: 9 of 26 red;
  - old italic regex: 1 red;
  - old code-span regex: 1 red;
  - raw-HTML pattern removed: 1 red.
- **Local gates at 8ff1d52:**
  - app-shell dependency-closure build, components and app-shell type-check: exit 0;
  - 98 test files naming the touched symbols: 3383 passed;
  - components suite in two shards (before the main merge): 4020 passed, 24 skipped;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:spec-symbols`, changeset presence: all 0;
  - eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.

NOT MEASURED: live reading, reason: no authored element:text Markdown in the showcase.

## Acceptance notes

- Inline raw-HTML skipping uses CommonMark's grammar. Plain text shaped like an open tag (a less-than sign directly followed by a letter, with a greater-than sign later in the same run of text) loses that span in element:text, where it used to print literally. This is the same grammar react-markdown applies with skipHtml.
- A Markdown destination ends at its first closing parenthesis, and a link title (`[a](url "t")`) is not supported. Such a destination contains whitespace and is refused, so the link prints as its text.
